_about: Patches for Raw Danger! builds. Addresses are EE virtual addresses in the boot ELF. rd_mkconfig.py checks each address against your ELF, sorts it into CODE (baked in at recompile time via config.toml [patches]) or DATA (applied at boot by rd_game.cpp, toggled in rawdanger.ini), and refuses any site whose original value doesn't match 'expect'.
